Morning team —

We’re on the final stretch for Q3 close. I’ve attached an updated tally (Q3-close-tally-v2.xlsx) and a short checklist. Please do the following by EOD local time: 

- Update "stage" on any open opportunities that will not commit this quarter (mark as "no-commit" + reason).
- Confirm PO / procurement status for your deals in column G.
- Flag any legal or billing redlines preventing invoicing.

Key asks: 
1) David — can you confirm the Acme PO ETA and whether finance has an expected invoice date?
2) Priyom — we need final commit numbers for the two VAR renewals by 3pm.
3) Laura — please run the tally against AR projections and flag mismatches.

Attachments: Q3-close-tally-v2.xlsx (workbook), close-playbook.pdf (one-page runbook).

I’ll consolidate responses at 4pm and publish the rollup. Quick replies are fine.

Thanks —
Soojin
